textRuns.value: Scope: EFFIS burnt-area perimeters (Copernicus EMS / JRC), 2016 to 2026. 2026 is a season in progress. This page and the pages Scale, Where, When, Severity and Why cover European countries only (EU and non-EU Europe). Country and Live season read the whole EFFIS scope, which also holds North African and Middle Eastern countries; France uses the French BDIFF database.
